summary: Issue #571 (bundling #550 and two deck-builder findings from the architectural review, per Mendon's request to do these three as one standalone PR before the larger DeckSurface.Relayout item): (1) MatchEngine.Clone() replaces RoomManager.SubmitAsync's MatchEngine.Replay(ExportReplay()) trial -- Execute() already validates atomically via its own copy-then-rollback on _state, so cloning the live state directly (O(state size)) replaces replaying every prior command from turn one (O(n), O(n^2) over a match); (2) DeckBuilderScreen caches the catalogue-wide DeckCardInfo[] pool once instead of rebuilding it (with real per-card ability lookups) on every NewDraft() call, fixing BuildDeckList()'s O(saved decks x catalogue size) cost on every visit to My decks; (3) DeckSkin.Icon() memoizes its 7 possible SVG-rasterized textures (verified no caller mutates the returned Texture2D; Plate() is left alone since callers DO mutate its StyleBoxTexture).
validation: bash tools/check.sh --skip-client passed in full three times (2277/2277, EXIT=0) across: the initial implementation, after dotnet format whitespace on all touched files (required once any part of a file is touched), and a final confirmation run. dotnet build succeeds for L5R.Core, L5R.Server and L5R.Client. Added tests/L5R.Core.Tests/MatchEngineCloneTests.cs: proves Clone() and Replay(ExportReplay()) produce byte-identical views and RNG state after ~30 varied commands (so the next command lands identically on both independently-executed trials), and that _customDecks and state detachment survive Clone() for a Custom Practice match. The existing PersistenceRollback test (tests/L5R.Server.Tests) continues to guard the property the outer trial/promote pattern exists for.
remaining: None; ready for review. Deck-builder finding #3 (DeckSurface.Relayout card-identity reconciliation) intentionally excluded -- Mendon asked for it as a separate follow-up PR after this one merges. The client-side changes (DeckBuilderScreen.cs, DeckSkin.cs) compile cleanly but were not visually verified in the running Godot client this session -- they are pure caching changes with no behavior change (confirmed via code reading: DeckCardInfo is an immutable record, DeckWorkshop's constructor only reads its input, and no caller mutates Icon()'s returned Texture2D).
